title: runstate v0.5 lifecycle convention
description: Pins the bodies of the lifecycle.* topics the worker produces: started (attach + self-reported liveness handle), heartbeat (tick beacon), stopped (cooperative dying breath), nak (a refused control request), bound (a lease bound to the episode that registered it). Applied on top of the envelope schema. v0.4 added a required `t` to started/heartbeat/stopped (docs/specs/observer-clock.md). v0.5 is REFERENCE BY NAME: a record that speaks for an episode names its claim (`claim_seq` = the seq of the lifecycle.started it speaks for) on heartbeat/stopped/bound; stopped names the stops it honored (`honored`, request_ids); and the new `lifecycle.bound` names the lease (envelope request_id) and its claim. Readers relate records by these names, never by log position.

Started.description: Pushed on attach; the worker self-reports its liveness handle (§8). t is the worker's wall-clock at attach (required non-null) -- the run epoch, and one uniform clock across the lifecycle event records. It was `attached_at` (present-nullable) before the observer-clock harmonization.

Heartbeat.description: Tick-driven liveness beacon. consumed_seq is the worker's read position in its inbound `control` order (§11-12), published after durable registration. claim_seq names the episode the beat speaks for (the seq of its lifecycle.started). t is the worker's wall-clock when it beat -- what lets a third-party observer date the beacon and answer staleness (observer-clock).

Stopped.description: The cooperative dying breath; its existence on the log = a clean, resumable halt (§7). completed=true is the worker's opt-in claim of intrinsic completion; otherwise the stop projects to preempted. error is the failure diagnostic; a completed stop carries no error. claim_seq names the episode it ends (null: a run that never claimed). honored names the control.stop request_ids in the worker's pending set when it stopped, due or not -- a stop is pending until some stopped names it or a nak refuses it. t is the worker's wall-clock at the dying breath (the finish time / GC-age answer).

Bound.description: An episode-local subscription (a lease: time_seconds or count anywhere in its schedule), named by the envelope request_id, registered by the episode claim_seq names. The lease is void for every other episode, and for every reader once a terminal names its episode (docs/specs/time-lease-boundary.md, by name).

Nak.description: A refused control request, correlated by request_id. `reason` is a closed enum: malformed (body didn't conform -- a sender bug), unsatisfiable (well-formed but provably zero fires), unsupported (unknown control verb). `message` is free human detail.
